name: justcode-lang
description: Full Language Server (diagnostics, IntelliSense, definitions, hover, rename, semantic tokens) and syntax highlighting for JustCode (.jc)

commands.title: JMC Analyzer: Download / Update Language Server

jmc.analyzer.enableLsp.description: Start the jmc-analyzer language server for diagnostics, autocomplete, go to definition, hover, rename, and semantic tokens.

jmc.analyzer.autoDownload.description: Automatically download the jmc-analyzer language server from GitHub Releases if not found locally.

jmc.analyzer.serverPath.description: Path to the jmc-analyzer binary. Empty means look up `jmc-analyzer` on PATH.

jmc.analyzer.stdPath.description: Path to the JustCode standard library directory (std). Defaults to the bundled standard library included with this extension.

jmc.analyzer.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the jmc-analyzer language server.
